title: vps export JSON
description: Structured stdout payload for `ssh-cli vps export --json` (or global --output-format json), and the body written by `--output` in JSON mode. Two shapes, exactly one per run: the body (`schema_version` and `hosts`) when stdout receives the export, or the summary (`path` and `format`) when `-o`/`--output` wrote it to a file. Redacted by default (GAP-SSH-UX-001): the export clears `password` to an empty string and sets `sudo_password`, `su_password` and `key_passphrase` to null, and the fixed mask appears only in `vps list` and `vps show`. Never emits sshcli-enc ciphertext for empty secrets (EXP-001 parity). Each host carries `use_agent` and `agent_socket` when the host authenticates through the SSH agent, so an export of an agent host imports back as an agent host.

path.description: Only in the summary printed when `-o`/`--output` wrote the export to a file: the path that was written. The summary has no `hosts` and no `schema_version`.

format.description: Only in the `-o`/`--output` summary: the format of the file that was written, which follows the resolved output format

hosts.description: Map of host name → host object (redacted or with secrets)

additionalProperties.description: One exported host. Seven fields are conditional and vanish when unset rather than appearing empty: tags, tls, tls_sni, tls_client_cert, tls_client_key, use_agent, agent_socket. The remaining fields are always present, with `null` for an unset optional secret or path.

user.description: Wire key `user`, the same as `vps show` and `vps list`

password.description: Plaintext with --include-secrets. Empty string when redacted, because the export clears the value instead of masking it, and also empty when the host has no password. Use `vps show` to tell a key-only host apart.

key_path.description: Path of the private key, or null when the host has none

key_passphrase.description: Plaintext with --include-secrets, null when redacted or unset

sudo_password.description: Plaintext with --include-secrets, null when redacted or unset

su_password.description: Plaintext with --include-secrets, null when redacted or unset

tags.description: Host tags. Omitted when empty, never emitted as `[]`.

tls.description: True when SSH runs inside a rustls TLS tunnel. Omitted when false.

tls_sni.description: SNI presented on the TLS handshake. Omitted when unset.

tls_client_cert.description: Path of the mTLS client certificate. Omitted when unset.

tls_client_key.description: Path of the mTLS client key, never key material. Omitted when unset.

use_agent.description: True when the host authenticates through the SSH agent. Omitted when false, so absence means password or key auth.

agent_socket.description: Explicit agent socket or Windows named pipe path. Omitted when unset, meaning the platform default endpoint.
